_comment: Technique 3: redefining a shipped interiority profile. 'gloomy' is declared by
data/mcaconversations/interiority/personalities.json. Redefining the id replaces the whole
profile object - baselines and stance_bias together - so every axis the shipped profile set
has to be restated here or it silently reverts to 0.
This version is a dry-humoured gloomy: a joke lands on them instead of bouncing off, and
they hold back a little less. Everything else is the shipped profile, unchanged.
Baselines clamp to +/-15 and stance bias to +/-12, both less than one check-tier margin.
